purpose: Interpret relative choice among a complete set of eligible personal-care alternatives and the outside option.
limitations: Coefficients describe associations conditional on the captured choice set, not causal effects.
Incomplete alternative sets invalidate estimation and prediction.
Price interpretation is limited to EUR and ten-euro units in this version.
Independence of irrelevant alternatives must be tested before promotion.
rollback: Remove the choice-model signal and restore the approved deterministic ranking policy.
